Every query in `nes-systests/benchmark/` runs concurrently on one single-node worker.
After a fixed delay, the worker is checkpointed with `criu dump --leave-running`.
The selected query is stopped on the original and continues on a shadow restored from that checkpoint.
There, every other query is stopped, and Undo live-record is attached only then.
Baseline trials run the same 32 queries without a checkpoint or recording.

Render with `python scripts/criu-bench/bench.py report`. Rendering again with the same run ID reuses its results.

```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
run_id = "manual"
reps = 3
delay = 15
keep_artifacts = False
stall_seconds = 300
```

```{python}
#| label: run
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import analysis
import bench

completed = bench.run_experiment(run_id, reps=reps, delay_seconds=delay, stall_seconds=stall_seconds)
run_dir = bench.run_dir_of(run_id)
manifest = json.loads((run_dir / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
trials, queries = analysis.export_tables(run_dir)
print(f"run {run_id}: {manifest['status']}")
```

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

pd.DataFrame(
    [(key, value) for section in ("settings", "environment") for key, value in manifest[section].items()],
    columns=["setting", "value"],
)
```

## Trials

```{python}
#| label: trials
trials[["trial", "kind", "success", *[c for c in ("error",) if c in trials]]]
```

```{python}
#| label: summary
analysis.summarize(trials, [
    "offload_query_seconds", "cohort_seconds", "dump_seconds", "restore_seconds",
    "stop_others_seconds", "attach_seconds", "shadow_after_attach_seconds",
    "image_bytes", "recording_bytes", "shadow_cpu_seconds", "shadow_peak_rss_bytes",
]).round(3)
```
